messages.subject: Round 911 source trace complete
messages.body: Traced the new diagnostic through pinned compute-runtime, Metrics Library, Metrics Discovery, and Xe OA source, and wrote the decision-support report at bench/results/2026-10-15-pr6-recovery-audit/research-round911-v1.txt (SHA256 bd247af566482d82bbcd09df74eb2628f057ed56a406114c512fee1933081af2). The source sequence points to Metrics Library TBS/context initialization failing before QueryCreate; deferred metric-group activation and an observation_paranoid=1 permission denial are consistent, but no ioctl errno was captured. One bounded syscall trace of the fixed GUID file and ADD_CONFIG/STREAM_OPEN results remains the discriminating next step; no runtime or device work was run.
